narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for Kellogg's Japan Granola. It uses a 'TED-talk' style presentation as a framing device to hook the audience, followed by relatable lifestyle scenarios (wanting more sleep, skipping breakfast). It presents the cereal as the perfect solution for a quick and nutritious breakfast, backed by nutritional facts and a physical demonstration of the product's quality and taste.
